data.definition: Teams with at least 30 games. Win rate = wins / games over all recorded games. Elo = rating after the team's last recorded game (inactive teams keep their last rating). Ratings include a league level learned from games between leagues, but they are still only comparable between leagues that play each other often. Lower-tier leagues mostly meet their regional neighbours, so their level against the major leagues is poorly identified and a dominant team in a small league can show a higher Elo than a top team in a major league. Filter by league to compare like with like.
